targets.query:
SELECT last("status_code") AS "Status",
       last("health_score") AS "Health",
       last("temperature_c") AS "Temp",
       last("media_errors") AS "Media",
       last("other_errors") AS "Other",
       last("predictive_failures") AS "Predictive",
       last("reallocated_sectors") AS "Reallocated",
       last("pending_sectors") AS "Pending",
       last("offline_uncorrectable") AS "Uncorrectable",
       last("crc_errors") AS "CRC"
FROM "raid_drive_status"
WHERE $timeFilter AND time > now() - 2m AND "controller" =~ /^$raid_controller$/
GROUP BY "controller","slot","model","serial","state"
